scope: Stored-state arithmetic at the independently CPU-verified D5 cell 5; no atmosphere, statistical-equilibrium or transfer solve.
formula: LTE(n3/n2) = sum_{n=3} g exp[-(E-E_offset)/(kB T)] / sum_{n=2} g exp[-(E-E_offset)/(kB T)]; actual ratio uses the corresponding saved population sums.
limitations: The aggregate n3/n2 ratio is far from Boltzmann equilibrium at this temperature. This does not isolate the process causing its departure.
A small collisional/effective-radiative upward ratio alone cannot bound the effect of collisions on a net or collective mode.
This is D5 only. No assertion is made about the final highest-density state until its saved fields are evaluated.
